summary.caption: A Chinese drama poster on a deep navy ground textured like painted canvas. A woman in a crystal-beaded strapless gown sits behind a plinth holding a small modelling knife, a white plaster bust carved into faceted planes standing in front of her on a metal platter. Crimson rose petals fall across the whole frame in sharp foreground streaks and soft background smears. Pale-gold serif characters crown the top third, the cast credit sits beside her shoulder, and a white pill, the four-character broadcast line and two platform lockups anchor the lower third.

items.label: character
items.caption: A young East Asian woman seated behind a plinth, facing the camera straight on with a faint closed-mouth smile. Her long black hair is parted in the middle and set in loose waves over her shoulders; she wears tall tiered silver drop earrings and a strapless gown of silver beadwork covered in scattered crystal droplets. Her right hand is lifted beside her face holding a small silver modelling knife between two fingers, and her bare shoulders catch the light.

items.label: object
items.caption: A white plaster bust of a head and neck standing on a dark metal platter, its surface scraped and cut away in faceted planes, with a band of pale ribbon studded with red stones around the neck and crimson petals caught at its base.

items.label: object
items.caption: The Tencent Video logo at the top left: a green, blue and orange play mark with white Chinese type across it.

items.label: object
items.caption: A white brush-script wordmark at the top right, the first two characters large and loose, the last two smaller and set beside them.

items.label: text
items.caption: A line of small white Chinese type, centred, naming the source novel.
items.text: 根据伊北同名小说《美人余》改编

items.label: text
items.caption: The title in three huge pale-gold serif characters, the strokes cut and abstracted so they read almost as architecture, edges catching a soft metallic sheen.

items.label: object
items.caption: A narrow vertical column of tiny pale latin type between the title characters, rotated to read downward.

items.label: text
items.caption: Three centred lines of small white Chinese type at the right of the figure: the performer, the word for 'as', and the character name, each with a tiny romanisation.
items.text:
李雪（李一桐）
饰
余梦
